Preserve source attribution and license evidence limited to the acquired SRD contents; explicitly record unacquired PHB/DMG/Monster Manual source revisions and unresolved rights/catalog gates, without claiming full 2024 coverage or a reviewed production RightsGrant.

Retain exact committed source/evidence identities, commands and results, relevant PDF visual inspection, known gaps and scoped devlog; edits remain confined to the independent source-pin area.

Keep public source unchanged; scratch under main artifacts/tmp/attempt and durable evidence under main development/evidence/srd-g07.
Use PDF skill read-only, bundled runtimes; no global/Homebrew/home changes and no screenshot timer.
No recursive delegation, queue changes or self approval.
